name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis, including an in-driver taste-funnel explore state and design-ratification state) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → optional /spec:design (mock-bound, deterministic fidelity gates) → /spec:build (spec-build-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, and the ledger row driven; test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, and repair held by the session) → /spec:review (spec-review-driver.js stepped, driver-stepped: deterministic legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros; verdict derived by verdict.js) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.54.0 — corpus derivation and the kill-match input (specs/20260901/08-corpus-derivation-and-kill-match.md): the replay corpus gains a `## Derived classes` region grown from the escape ledger — `spec/scripts/lib/replay-corpus.js`'s `parseCorpus`/`CORPUS_BAR` (2) is the one parser for both `replay.js` and `fleet-reader.js`. `replay.js --apply`/`--record` now refuse a `--class` outside the corpus (exit 2, valid ids named, nothing committed/appended) and a new `--pick-class` mode selects the next class to replay (fewest measurement rows, derived classes breaking ties first), retiring replay.md's own `--stats`-reading selection prose. `fleet-reader.js --json` gains `escapes.corpusGaps` (classes at or past the bar with no corpus section) and `escapes.registry` (every effective class, corpus membership flagged); `/spec:escape` reads `escapes.registry` for its `class` field and warns on a corpus gap after appending. Reviewer returns now carry `file`/`line` (explicit null when absent) on every killed claim, enforced at the `reviewer-returned` mark, so `/spec:escape`'s `killedMatch` derivation compares by file first. `replay-corpus.md`'s first derived class, `prefix-collision-coverage-fail-open`, is authored from the escaped `ac-matrix.js` prefix-collision fix. 7.53.0 — escape class contract (specs/20260901/07-escape-class-contract.md): every escape row now carries either a validated defect class or an explicit `unclassedReason` (`no-fix-diff`|`deferred`); `spec/scripts/lib/escape-row.js` is the one validator and `spec/scripts/escape-row.js` the one writer (`--check`, `--append` duplicate-refusing, `--amend`), retiring escape.md's `printf` append. A historical row's class is repaired by an append-only `stage:"escape-class"` amendment keyed by the original's `ts`+`spec`+`file`; latest amendment wins. `fleet-reader.js` counts recurrences on the joined (row + amendment) class, lists rows still needing a class as `escapes.unclassedRows`, and flags unvalidated rows in the drift census. `/spec:escape` classifies registry-first (fleet `byClass` keys plus the corpus's classes, before inventing a new id) and gains a one-time fleet-wide `--backfill` mode; `/spec:doctor` reports the backfill as due; core.md's Incident Policy Materiality bullet now cites the joined count. 7.52.0 — loop checkpoint fails closed (specs/20260901/05-checkpoint-fail-closed.md): a `--via loop` review that reaches `reviewer-returned` with no `.claude/spec-session.json` now parks at CHECKPOINT with a restart remedy (a stale plugin hook set is the usual cause — hooks load at session start, so `/clear` does not reload them) instead of degrading to a printed warning that admitted DISPOSITIONS with no ledger trace; the park lifts once any stamp appears. `spec-review-driver.js` records `checkpoint: {sessionId}` at `reviewer-returned` and refuses `--mark dispositions` until that condition clears; the sole other exit is `--mark dispositions … --skip-independence-check-because "<reason>"`, admitted only on a no-stamp park and refused everywhere else (a same-session park still names `/clear`; a run that isn't parked, or is `--via direct`, refuses the flag outright). `verdict.js` gains `--checkpoint <cleared|stamp-appeared|overridden|not-reached>` and `--checkpoint-reason <text>` (review profile only), writing `checkpoint: {outcome}` — with `reason` when `overridden` — onto every loop review row right after `verdict`, so how often the gate is skipped, and why, is a ledger query.
